tools.name: search
tools.description: Bounded cross-domain search: funds by name, stocks by ticker/name, and insider transactions by owner. The same scopes the web search uses. A blank or missing query returns empty buckets, mirroring GET /api/v1/search.

tools.name: get_fund
tools.description: One fund's latest filing and its investors.

tools.name: fund_holdings
tools.description: A fund's current portfolio positions with quarter-over-quarter change.

tools.name: fund_history
tools.description: Quarter-by-quarter filing history and a summary (turnover, concentration, favorites).

tools.name: get_stock
tools.description: One company as held by tracked funds: holders, values, and last-quarter moves.

tools.name: get_investor
tools.description: One investor's portfolio links (funds they run or back) and featured fund.

tools.name: insider_feed
tools.description: Recent Form 4/5 insider transactions across all held stocks, newest first. Filterable by transaction type and owner. Page 2+ requires FolioFact Pro.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetches an allowlisted public page as markdown/text: published blog posts (/blog/:slug), static pages (e.g. /agents, /api-docs, /about), and the agent discovery doc (/llms.txt).

tools.name: stock_earnings
tools.description: The latest cited earnings report for one stock. Teasers are public. Set include_full=true for the complete evidence-linked report; that content requires FolioFact Pro.

tools.name: stock_financials
tools.description: Financial statements (yearly and quarterly) and the valuation summary (enterprise value, FCF/EV and OCF/EV yields). Requires FolioFact Pro.

tools.name: stock_insiders
tools.description: Recent Form 4/5 insider transactions for one company. Requires FolioFact Pro.

tools.name: stock_options
tools.description: Daily 30-day implied volatility history for one company. Requires FolioFact Pro.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Aligned multi-stock comparison: valuation, latest financial point, fund conviction, and insider activity. Requires FolioFact Pro.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
